verdict.rationale: Shopify's own docs say apps can integrate into checkout and describe the checkout as customizable, and Shopify Extensions are mentioned as a validated artifact. That points to supported extension points rather than forking. However, nothing in the pack documents what can be customized, so only the general existence of checkout extensibility is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented checkout extension points for custom fields, branding/styling controls, discount logic customization, validation logic hooks, any limits or plan requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can customize checkout — fields, branding, discounts, and validation logic — through supported extension points rather than forking checkout

citations.quote: Extend Shopify's core functionality with apps that integrate into Shopify's admin, online store, checkout and more.
The world's highest-converting, customizable, one-click checkout powers 12% of US ecommerce
